title: EN1 — The AI that shows you the page
question: Explain in about 30 seconds how TRED proves an answer with my own PDF. Follow this storyline: Most AI tutors guess. TRED proves. Upload your lecture notes, ask a question, and TRED shows you the exact page in your PDF. Every citation is checked. Try it free at tred-tutor.de.

source.title: TRED — how citations work
source.content:
Most AI tutors answer from memory, so they can guess.
TRED answers from the lecture notes that the student uploads.
When TRED quotes a sentence from your notes, the server checks that the sentence is really written in your PDF.
A checked citation shows the file name and the exact page number of the sentence.
One click on the citation opens your PDF at that page, with the sentence highlighted.
If a quoted sentence is not found in the document, the citation is marked as not verified.
The three steps are: upload your lecture notes, ask a question, open the cited page.
You can try TRED for free at tred-tutor.de.
